_doc: Nam Phố Đường's Effect engine records (world-depth Stage 6; ADR-0009). Merged into assets/data/combat_effects.json under source world-depth:nam_pho by the serial step. Unpriced. Rule text from design/world/depth/sects/nam_pho.items.json.

Dawn Ink.rule: Southern Shore Cloud Seal: Wood debuff batches your talismans lay in the first 10 s of a fight last 50 % longer, and each Wood debuff batch that expires unspent returns 2 % of your maximum linh lực.
Dawn Ink.approx: "talismans you lay" is read on the Wood debuff batches laid by your talisman arts: batches laid in the first 10 s gain stack_dur 50, and each Wood batch ending naturally (batch_ended) returns 2 % of maximum linh lực.

Paper Laid at Dawn.rule: The Dawn Half, full set (3 pieces): talismans you lay cost no linh lực up to the engine's 95 % cap until they fire, and for every 10 s a laid talisman stays unspent you gain 1 Dawn Growth: each growth gives your talisman arts 10 % more damage and 1 extra Wood stack on hit (once per firing), and costs 2 % of your maximum linh lực when a talisman fires.
Paper Laid at Dawn.approx: cost reduction stops at cost_red_cap (0.95); growth ticks once every 10 s while laid_talisman >= 1, scales all talisman arts, and subtracts 2 % max linh lực per growth when a talisman fires while qi_share >= 0.06.

Roll Up the Western Rain.rule: The Dusk Half, full set (3 pieces): when the foe is Broken, or sheds your Wood stacks (by cleanse or natural expiry), each stack shed heals you for 1 % of your health and removes 1 debuff stack.
